evidence: Modifies src/wallet/test/coinselector_tests.cpp to test GenerateChangeTarget in wallet coin selection.
rationale: Adds unit test coverage to protect against regressions in coin selection change randomization that preserves wallet transaction privacy. As noted in the description, 'You could widen the range, or make it not random anymore, and every test would still pass', and mutation testing verified catching off-by-one errors and skewed distributions.
